Write a model the way Statistical Rethinking writes it for ulam(). The studio parses it, builds the log-posterior with automatic gradients, and samples it with NUTS in your browser.

How the parser read it

    What the parser understands

    Positive priors (dexp, dlnorm, dgamma, dhalfnorm, dhalfcauchy) keep the parameter positive by sampling its log, and dbeta and dunif keep it inside its bounds, with the Jacobian added as Stan does. Text after # is a comment. Pasted ulam( alist( ... ) , data=dd ) works: only the alist is read.
